task: Implemented daemon mode for silver-etl using London TDD with mock-driven development
critique:
## Patterns Used
1. **deploy-docker-architecture** - Referenced for Docker service structure
2. **air-quality-app main loop** - Used as reference implementation for daemon pattern

## Approach
- London TDD (outside-in): Started with CLI tests, then daemon behavior tests using mocks
- Used mockall crate for trait mocking (EtlExecutor trait)
- Handled DuckDB non-Sync issue with Mutex wrapper
- Separated one-shot (silver profile) from daemon (silver-daemon profile)

## Key Learnings
1. DuckDB Connection is not Sync - needed Mutex wrapper instead of Arc
2. tokio::watch is better than oneshot for ongoing shutdown signaling
3. Trait-based design enables easy mocking for TDD
4. Docker profiles enable clean separation of run modes

## Files Modified
- apps/silver-etl/src/main.rs - Added Daemon command
- apps/silver-etl/src/daemon.rs - New daemon module
- apps/silver-etl/src/lib.rs - Export daemon module
- apps/silver-etl/Cargo.toml - Added mockall dev-dependency
- deploy/pi/docker-compose.yml - Added silver-etl-daemon service
- deploy/pi/deploy.sh - Added daemon commands
